productConcept.name: Maison Cendré
productConcept.description: Single-origin Atlantic caviar and rare marine cures, harvested from the cold tidal waters of the Basque coast.
productConcept.rationale: The warm dark luxury palette (#1a1a18 near-black, #b1ada7 warm greige, Playfair Display editorial serif) maps directly to the premium artisan food register — caviar, marine cures, French terroir. 'Cendré' (ash) aligns with the dark organic warmth of the palette. The deceleration-dominance motion system (nothing snaps, languid settling) matches the 'slow food' positioning. The generous spacing system (213px section gaps) enforces luxury restraint.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — GSAP detected in motion system, durations 0.7s–1.1s, ScrollTrigger patterns, languid deceleration-only easing
